description: Source code for a native simulator CPU emulator, providing functions to initialize, terminate, control, and query the CPU emulation state, including thread synchronization mechanisms.

methods.name: nce_init
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new instance of the CPU emulator state.

methods.name: nce_terminate
methods.description: Terminates the CPU emulator, cleaning up resources and signaling shutdown.

methods.name: nce_boot_cpu
methods.description: Starts the CPU emulation by spawning a thread and running the start routine.

methods.name: nce_halt_cpu
methods.description: Halts the CPU emulation, suspending execution until resumed.

methods.name: nce_wake_cpu
methods.description: Wakes the CPU from a halted state, resuming execution.

methods.name: nce_is_cpu_running
methods.description: Returns whether the CPU is currently running.
